ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white/cream and 60% low-intensity black/dark grey across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous blobs occupy the distal 50-60% of both the left and right lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are concentrated in the medial region and extend towards the trailing edge. Numerous small, low-intensity pixel clusters and linear streaks are embedded within the distal white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge. The pixel-amplitude of these peaks and valleys increases noticeably in the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping trajectory. The overall curve is primarily convex along the leading margins with a complex, multi-segmented curve along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular clusters of white pixels (barnacles) are localized at the extreme lateral tips and along the upper-distal margins of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, non-parallel, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected predominantly in the dark central region and crossing into the white distal areas.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization localized at both fluke tips; dense concentration of linear rake marks across the central fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of medium-intensity brownish/yellowish pixel patches (consistent with diatom film) visible within the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.
